intended_behavior: Add a private boolean _dirty attribute initialized to False. Modify set() and delete() methods to set _dirty = True upon modification. Add private methods _is_dirty() to return the current dirty state and _clear_dirty() to reset it to False. This enables tracking of mutable state changes to control conditional persistence.

Modify sync_agent to maintain a cached record of the last synced agent internal state. Before calling update_agent, check if agent.state._is_dirty() is True or if the current _internal_state differs from the cached snapshot. Only proceed with update_agent if either condition is met. Upon successful update, reset the dirty flag via _clear_dirty() and update the cached internal state. On failure, keep the dirty flag set for retry. This reduces unnecessary data writes while preserving existing behavior.
